description: Agent Harness · Codex hooks（跨平台版）。Windows 使用 Python，macOS/Linux 通过 sh 包装器调用同一实现。

hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; python -X utf8 (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/harness_hook.py') 'detect-feedback-signal'"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; python -X utf8 (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/harness_hook.py') 'check-evolution'"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; python -X utf8 (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/harness_hook.py') 'pre-tool-shell'"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; python -X utf8 (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/harness_hook.py') 'auto-push'"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; python -X utf8 (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/harness_hook.py') 'mark-review-needed'"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; python -X utf8 (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/harness_hook.py') 'stop-gate'"
